WITH up_state AS (
  INSERT INTO public.conversation_state (conversation_key, tenant_id, restaurant_id, channel, user_id, state_json)
  VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_key) DO UPDATE
    SET state_json=EXCLUDED.state_json, updated_at=now()
  RETURNING 1
),
up_cart AS (
  INSERT INTO public.carts (conversation_key, cart_json)
  VALUES ($1, $7::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_key) DO UPDATE
    SET cart_json=EXCLUDED.cart_json, updated_at=now()
  RETURNING 1
),
up_pref AS (
  INSERT INTO public.customer_preferences(tenant_id, phone, locale)
  SELECT $2, $5, $9
  WHERE COALESCE($8::boolean,false) = true
    AND $9 IS NOT NULL
    AND length(trim($9)) > 0
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, phone) DO UPDATE
    SET locale=EXCLUDED.locale, updated_at=now()
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT 1 AS ok;

SELECT s.slot_id, to_char(s.start_time,'HH24:MI') AS start_time, to_char(s.end_time,'HH24:MI') AS end_time, s.capacity,
       GREATEST(s.capacity - COALESCE(r.cnt,0),0) AS remaining
FROM public.delivery_time_slots s
LEFT JOIN (SELECT slot_id, count(*) cnt FROM public.delivery_slot_reservations GROUP BY slot_id) r ON r.slot_id=s.slot_id
WHERE s.restaurant_id=$1::uuid
  AND s.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (now() at time zone 'Europe/Paris'))::int
  AND s.is_active=true
ORDER BY s.start_time ASC
LIMIT 6;

WITH up_state AS (
      INSERT INTO conversation_state (conversation_key, tenant_id, restaurant_id, channel, user_id, state_json)
      VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb)
      ON CONFLICT (conversation_key) DO UPDATE
        SET state_json=EXCLUDED.state_json, updated_at=now()
      RETURNING 1
    ),
    up_cart AS (
      INSERT INTO carts (conversation_key, cart_json)
      VALUES ($1, $7::jsonb)
      ON CONFLICT (conversation_key) DO UPDATE
        SET cart_json=EXCLUDED.cart_json, updated_at=now()
      RETURNING 1
    )
    SELECT 1 AS ok;

INSERT INTO public.security_events (tenant_id, restaurant_id, conversation_key, user_id, event_type, details) VALUES ($1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3::text,$4::text,'ADDRESS_AMBIGUOUS', jsonb_build_object('missing_fields',$5::jsonb));

INSERT INTO outbound_messages(dedupe_key, tenant_id, restaurant_id, conversation_key, channel, user_id, order_id, template, payload_json, status, next_retry_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,'PENDING', now(), now())
ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO UPDATE
  SET payload_json=EXCLUDED.payload_json,
      status = CASE WHEN outbound_messages.status='SENT' THEN outbound_messages.status ELSE 'PENDING' END,
      updated_at=now()
RETURNING outbound_id, status;
